messages:
Sam (Eng): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands security Q&A. A prospect wants to include our Private VPC deployment in their SOC2 attestation. Is that possible?

Riley (Security): Short answer: shared responsibility. Our SOC2 covers Redwoods control plane and managed services; Private/VPC infra is customer-controlled. We provide a SOC2 mapping pack (control mappings + evidence templates) to help auditors.

Noor (Product): Product note: we'll add a "Customer Audit Guide" page explaining how to map Redwood artifacts into a customer's SOC2 scope and what auditors typically expect.

Sam (Eng): They also asked if Redwood can produce signed proof of audit-log integrity + KMS rotations for auditors.

Riley (Security): Yes. We can generate an evidence bundle with chain-hashes for log batches, signed rotation events, and an integration log showing KMS calls (references only). For BYOK we record key ARNs/grants but never store plaintext key material.

Pat (Privacy): Heads up: retention >12 months can have privacy/regulatory implications by region. If they want multi-year retention (e.g., 7 years), loop legal/privacy early. Also need documented DSAR/redaction workflow for archived logs.

Sam (Eng): Any quick CLI to request an evidence bundle or enable S3 export?

Riley (Security): Example CLI snippets:
```
# enable export to customer S3 (Private)
redwoodctl logs export enable --dep dp-abc --target s3://cust-audit --encrypt --kms arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/abcd

# create an evidence bundle for a date range
redwoodctl audit bundle create --deployment dp-abc --start 2024-01-01 --end 2024-12-31 --include-rotations --output s3://cust-evidence
```
Ensure VPC endpoints, IAM grants, and lifecycle policies are in place. Full flags in docs.

Noor (Product): Roadmap: audit-bundle self-serve & key lifecycle UI planned next quarter (beta).

Sam (Eng): Great. I'll pass this back to the prospect.
